heroHeadline: CENTCOM Briefs Trump on New Iran Strike Options as He Rejects Hormuz Deal; Fed Holds in Powell's Final Meeting; DOJ Rolls Back 34 Gun Rules
heroSubtitle: On April 30 (Day 62 of the Iran war), CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on a new menu of 'short and powerful' strike options against Iran after Trump rejected Tehran's latest Hormuz proposal, telling Iran to 'just give up.' Brent crude briefly topped $100/bbl intraday. The Federal Reserve voted 8-4 to hold rates at 3.5–3.75% in Jerome Powell's final FOMC meeting; the Senate Banking Committee advanced Trump's nominee Kevin Warsh as next Fed chair 13-12. The DOJ released 34 proposed gun regulation rollbacks under EO 14206 — the largest ATF reform in a decade — and Congress finalized the 2026 budget resolution unlocking $70B in ICE/CBP reconciliation funding (Senate floor vote targeting May 11). The day before, the Supreme Court's 6-3 conservative majority gutted the Voting Rights Act in Louisiana v. Callais, limiting Section 2 remedies and potentially threatening 15+ majority-minority congressional districts.
